scenario: A translational oncology team studying colorectal cancer performs the following experiment: An analyst tests for differential gene expression between adjacent tissue regions by treating 4,000 Visium capture spots on a single coronal brain slice as independent observations. They collect samples and execute computational modeling.
question: Critique the methodology of this colorectal cancer study. Identify any fatal methodological flaws, explain the underlying biological and statistical mechanisms, provide rigorous corrections, and establish whether reported biological claims are warranted.
ground_truth_rationale: Authoritative scientific rationale: Spatial transcriptomics spots exhibit strong spatial autocorrelation and are technical sub-observations of a single biological slice (N=1). Treating spots as independent yields massive type I error; spatial mixed models or multi-slice pseudobulk are necessary. In colorectal_cancer biology, failing to account for this leads to erroneous translational conclusions.
